original_bug_description: A use-of-uninitialized-value in htmlParseHTMLAttribute (HTMLparser.c) can cause an out-of-bounds read / global-buffer-overflow while parsing HTML attribute values. The parser may read past a local buffer into adjacent global memory, leading to crashes, incorrect behavior, or potential information disclosure.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=6314169344589824: libxml2 has a reported memory-safety bug. A use-of-uninitialized-value in htmlParseHTMLAttribute (HTMLparser.c) can cause an out-of-bounds read / global-buffer-overflow while parsing HTML attribute values. The parser may read past a local buffer into adjacent global memory, leading to crashes, incorrect behavior, or potential information disclosure.
